name: requirements_update
description: Update a requirement entry. type = fr|tr|test|mapping. Omitted title/body values keep the current value.

type.description: Entry type: fr, tr, test, or mapping

id.description: Entry id (FR/TR/TEST id or FR id for mapping rows)

body.description: Updated body text or mapping TR id list

testIds.description: Updated comma-separated TEST ids for mapping rows
